description: 💡 Before multi-step work, check find_skill / list_workflows for canonical recipes. Update fields on an existing record. values: {field: value, ...}. Writes both form-view fields and model fields not exposed in the form view. One2many / many2many fields accept Odoo Command tuples directly: [[0,0,{vals}]] create+link, [[1,id,{vals}]] update line, [[2,id]] delete line, [[6,0,[ids]]] replace set. Pass context to control write behaviour — e.g. {lang: "fr_FR"} writes the value for that language on translate=True fields, {mail_notrack: true} suppresses chatter entries. Returns {success, updated_fields, non_form_fields} or {error}.
name: update
